title: ManasJS
description: ManasJS adds proper KubejS support to the ManasCore library that supports multiple mods such as Tensura Reincarnated, it includes events including for skill obtainment and removal
body: ManasJS adds proper KubeJS support to ManasCore, the shared library behind mods like Tensura: Reincarnated. Script skill and race behavior from kubejs/server_scripts/ with events for skill obtainment and removal, activation, cooldowns, race changes, and damage, and actions to programmatically add or remove skills, set or evolve races, and override cooldowns and mastery.
